scope: repeated server-command streams: high seq numbers made the client drop the later snapshot

experiment_1.result: state stayed 9, usercmd 0, messageAck 1 - the snapshot seq 5 was older than the last command seq 4019 and got dropped

fix.command_seq_rule: command_seq + repeat index (4,5,6,...) so every outbound seq increases
fix.result: state 10, usercmd 17, messageAck 1053 - the snapshot was accepted

rendering.state_9_screenshot: loading screen visible behind the desktop chat window (unique=3438, mean=52)
rendering.reading: the loading screen renders correctly in state 9; the game view is black in state 10, matching the user's observation

answer_to_question.current_mode: protocol-level server stand-in: the client runs its native connect path (getchallenge -> connect -> stats -> gamestate -> snapshots) and loads mp_cross_fire itself
answer_to_question.not_forced: no clc.state memory patch and no UI skip; the client decides to enter the map
answer_to_question.not_room_hosting: the server has no world/level/match logic yet; it only speaks the wire protocol
answer_to_question.why_black: the base snapshot has an empty actor block and no client entities, so the game layer has no local player/camera to render
